summary: FHLBNY filed an 8-K reporting director election results under Item 5.02(d), not a special situation. Two New Jersey Member Director seats were filled unopposed: Anthony Labozzetta (Provident Bank CEO) and Ira Robbins (Valley National CEO) were deemed elected under FHFA rules, terms starting January 1, 2027; Robbins gets a four-year term to December 31, 2030, Labozzetta one year to December 31, 2027. Ballots for two Districtwide Independent Director seats follow in October 2026. No deal terms, no arbitrage angle; 2027 compensation plan undisclosed.
